SerializedData.Name: ReRollNumAffixes
SerializedData.Tooltip:
Used by blacksmith to <color=Highlight>re-roll the number of affixes</color> on an item up to a maximum of 4.

Will always generate atleast 1 affix.

Player magic find is not included in the roll, but there is a higher chance than normal to find more affixes and higher rarity.

SerializedData.Name: AddAffix
SerializedData.Tooltip:
Used by blacksmith to add a new random affix to an item, up to a maximum of 6.
Will always generate affix rarity E.

SerializedData.Name: Link
SerializedData.Tooltip:
Used by blacksmith to link two affixes of the highest rarity on an item.

When merging a linked item to another item, both affixes will be transfered if the target items contains those affixes, otherwise, only the highest rarity affix will be transfered, just like a normal merge.

If you merge to a linked affix, the links will be removed.
When re-linking an item, all existing links will be removed
